title: wix: move extcap features to a new toggle and change defaults
description: This makes the WiX installer closer to the current .exe installer during extcap installation, by moving the "extcap" to a separate section. I've also ported the same defaults that the current .exe for consistency (on windows: do not include ciscodump/sshdump/udpdump by default).

notes.body: added this merge request to the [merge train](https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_trains) at position 2
